listing.summary: StepSpeedup is a utility mod that lets you step the game speed up and down with the + and - keys, through a list of (configurable) speed multipliers: x1, x2, x4, x6, x8, x16 by default.
listing.aiSummary: Lets you step game speed up and down using configurable multipliers in combat and campaign.

description:
StepSpeedup is a utility mod that lets you step the game speed up and down with the + and - keys, through a list of (configurable) speed multipliers: x1, x2, x4, x6, x8, x16 by default.

This works in both combat and the campaign. It is recommended to enable the Campaign "speed up time" is a toggle game setting, and keep "speed up" enabled. You can step down to x1 for normal speed. It also works with the standard non-toggle setting.

Version Checker supported. Utility mod: safe to add to or remove from an existing save.

Why another speed mod?

SpeedUp by DarkRevenant is the established speed mod, and it works well. It is built around separate hotkeys that each hold or toggle a fixed multiplier, and multipliers from several active hotkeys stack together.

StepSpeedup takes a simpler approach: one list of speeds, and two keys to move through it. Rather than enabling and disabling speedup, you can step down to x1, making it always simple to speed up or slow down.

How it works

Combat: + and - change the combat engine's time multiplier directly. Every battle starts at x1 (with an option to keep the multiplier between battles). A message is shown for each change. Speeds below x1 work in combat.

Campaign: Campaign "speed up time" is a toggle setting is recommended. Enable "speed up time", then use + and - to step through speeds, including down to x1 for normal speed.

Speeds below x1: the game only supports slow motion in combat. You can add values like 0.5 to the speed list, but they only have an effect in combat.

Installation

Copy the stepspeedup folder into your Starsector mods folder.
Enable StepSpeedup in the launcher.

Configuration

Settings are in data/config/StepSpeedup.json:

Setting Default Description
speeds [1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 16] The speed list. x1 and x2 are always included, and the list is sorted automatically.
speedUpKeys [13, 78] Keys that step up: =/+ and numpad +. Uses LWJGL key codes.
slowDownKeys [12, 74] Keys that step down: - and numpad -.
allowKeyRepeat false If true, holding a key keeps stepping.
resetEachBattle true Reset combat speed to x1 at the start of each battle.
enableCampaign true Control the campaign speed-up multiplier.
showMessages true Show a message when the speed changes.

Key presses with Ctrl or Alt held are ignored, so they're left for the game and other mods.
Very high speeds make combat less accurate, because the game simulates bigger time steps per frame.

AI disclaimer

The majority of this mod was written by Claude (including some of the graphics). I made additions, edits and changes, and have reviewed every line of code.

Changelog

1.0.0

Initial release
